# pve_sdn_fabric_ospf (Data Source)

Reads a single OSPF SDN fabric (`GET /cluster/sdn/fabrics/fabric/{id}`) with its node members. When `node` is set, the live per-node fabric state (interfaces, neighbors, routes as reported by FRR) is read from `GET /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/...`; the runtime attributes stay null otherwise. Runtime state only exists once `pve_sdn_apply` has pushed the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the OSPF fabric including live per-node state from pve1.
data "pve_sdn_fabric_ospf" "ospf1" {
  fabric_id = "ospf1"
  node      = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) The fabric identifier to look up.

### Optional

- `node` (String) Cluster node whose live fabric state (interfaces, neighbors, routes) should be read. When unset those attributes remain null.

### Read-Only

- `area` (String) OSPF area, either an IPv4 address or a 32-bit number.
- `digest` (String) Configuration digest of the fabric.
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Live fabric interfaces on `node` (from `GET /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/interfaces`); null when `node` is unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `ip6_prefix` (String) IPv6 prefix (CIDR) node addresses are drawn from.
- `ip_prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix (CIDR) node addresses are drawn from.
- `neighbors` (Attributes List) Live fabric neighbors on `node` (from `GET /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/neighbors`); null when `node` is unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neighbors))
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Per-node member entries of the fabric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `redistribute` (Attributes List) Route sources redistributed into OSPF, each with an optional route map filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redistribute))
- `route_filter` (String) Prefix list used to filter routes installed into the kernel routing table.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Live fabric routes on `node` (from `GET /nodes/{node}/sdn/fabrics/{fabric}/routes`); null when `node` is unset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the network interface.
- `state` (String) Current state of the interface as reported by FRR.
- `type` (String) Interface type inside the fabric (e.g. `Point-to-Point`, `Broadcast`).


<a id="nestedatt--neighbors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `neighbors`

Read-Only:

- `neighbor` (String) IP or hostname of the neighbor.
- `status` (String) Adjacency status of the neighbor as reported by FRR (e.g. `Full`).
- `uptime` (String) Uptime of the adjacency as reported by FRR (e.g. `8h24m12s`).


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Network interfaces participating in OSPF on this node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--interfaces))
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address of this node inside the fabric.
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address of this node inside the fabric.
- `node_id` (String) The cluster node name.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IPv4 address (CIDRv4) for this interface.
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address (CIDRv6) for this interface.
- `name` (String) Name of the network interface.
- `network_type` (String) OSPF network type of the interface: `broadcast`, `non-broadcast`, `point-to-multipoint`, or `point-to-point`.



<a id="nestedatt--redistribute"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redistribute`

Read-Only:

- `route_map` (String) Route map filtering or transforming routes redistributed from this source.
- `source` (String) The protocol routes are redistributed from: `bgp`, `connected`, `kernel`, or `static`.


<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `route` (String) CIDR block of the routing table entry.
- `via` (List of String) Next-hop addresses for the route.
